name: Bardett Cone Filter Voxelization
aliases: Filtered voxelization with Bardett cone filter
definition: A volume sampling technique using a cone filter to approximate object details, preferred for objects with sharp details despite introducing nonlinear density profiles.
summary: Bardett Cone Filter Voxelization uses a cone filter to preserve sharp edges in small details, but its nonlinear density profile causes surface normal errors and artifacts.
